# Jora Mechanical Systems

> Jora Mechanical Systems (Saskatchewan): TSASK-licensed heating, cooling, gas and hot water contractor serving Saskatoon and area (Warman, Martensville, Osler, Dalmeny, Langham, Delisle, Clavet) plus Regina, Prince Albert and Moose Jaw. Furnaces, garage and shop heaters, boilers, AC, heat pumps, tankless water heaters. SaskEnergy rebate help. Phone 905-667-2823, email info@joramechanicalsystems.com, emergency service 24/7. Free in-home quotes. No general plumbing in Saskatchewan. The Ontario (GTA) site is at https://joramechanicalsystems.com/gta/.

Licensing: TSASK Licensed, TSASK Gas Fitters, Red Seal refrigeration mechanics, National Building Code, CSA B149 Gas Code, Permits Pulled, WCB Saskatchewan, Fully Insured.
Brands installed: Lennox, Carrier, Trane, Goodman, Kepler, TOSOT, Midea, Gree, Rinnai, Navien, Rheem, Bradford White, Noritz, Reznor, Modine, Re-Verber-Ray.

## Services
- [Furnace installation & replacement](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/furnaces/): New high-efficiency gas furnaces, sized for a −40 °C prairie winter and installed by TSASK-licensed gas fitters with a TSASK gas permit.
- [Air conditioner installation](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/air-conditioners/): Prairie summers hit 30 °C+. Quiet, efficient central air — sized properly and installed by journeyperson refrigeration mechanics.
- [Heat pump installation](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/heat-pumps/): One system that heats and cools. In Saskatchewan we pair cold-climate heat pumps with a gas furnace so you're never left cold at −40 °C.
- [Tankless water heaters](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/tankless-water-heaters/): Endless hot water, more space in the basement — and a $1,000 SaskEnergy rebate on qualifying units installed by a TSASK-licensed contractor.
- [Garage & shop heaters](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/garage-heaters/): Start the truck in a warm garage at −35 °C. Gas unit heaters, ceramic infrared heaters, electric heaters and patio heaters — installed with a TSASK permit.
- [24/7 heating & cooling repair](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/hvac-repair/): No heat at −30 °C is an emergency. Call 905-667-2823 any time — day, night, weekends and holidays.
- [Water heater replacement](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/water-heaters/): Tank water heaters replaced fast — gas, propane or electric — with SaskEnergy rebates of $250 to $1,000 on qualifying models.
- [Ductwork design & installation](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/ductwork/): Cold bonus rooms over the garage and chilly basements are usually duct problems. We design, build and fix ductwork.
- [Whole-home humidifiers](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/humidifiers/): Prairie winter air is extremely dry. A humidifier on your furnace adds moisture to every room automatically.
- [Smart thermostats](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/smart-thermostats/): Check on your home's heat from anywhere — and get an alert if the furnace stops while you're away in January.
- [HRV & ERV ventilation](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/hrv-erv/): Fresh air in, stale air out — while recovering most of the heat. ENERGY STAR HRVs qualify for a $100 SaskEnergy rebate.
- [Boilers & in-floor heating](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/boilers/): Quiet, even heat for in-floor radiant slabs, garages, shops and radiators — with SaskEnergy rebates may be available.
- [Indoor air quality](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/indoor-air-quality/): Better filtration on your furnace — for prairie dust, allergies, pets and summer wildfire smoke.
- [Maintenance & tune-ups](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/hvac-maintenance/): A yearly tune-up before the first hard freeze keeps your heat safe and reliable — and helps keep warranties valid.
- [Commercial HVAC](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/commercial-hvac/): Rooftop units, make-up air, unit heaters and ventilation for shops, offices, restaurants, clinics and plazas.
- [Industrial & shop HVAC](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/industrial-hvac/): Heating and ventilation for warehouses, farm shops, quonsets and plants — radiant tube heaters, unit heaters, make-up air, exhaust and gas lines.

## Products
- [Lennox Elite EL296V Gas Furnace](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/lennox-el296v/): Two-stage, variable-speed comfort with up to 96% AFUE.
- [Lennox Signature SLP99V Gas Furnace](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/lennox-slp99v/): Lennox's premium modulating furnace — up to 99% AFUE.
- [Carrier Comfort 96 Gas Furnace (59SC6)](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/carrier-59sc6/): Reliable Carrier heat with up to 97% AFUE.
- [Trane S9V2-VS Gas Furnace](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/trane-s9v2/): 97% AFUE, two-stage, variable-speed — built tough.
- [Goodman GMVC96 Gas Furnace](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/goodman-gmvc96/): 96% AFUE two-stage furnace — strong value.
- [Kepler High-Efficiency Gas Furnace](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/kepler-furnace/): Modern design, steady efficient warmth.
- [Lennox Elite EL16XC1 Air Conditioner](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/lennox-el16xc1/): Quiet, efficient central air — up to 17 SEER.
- [Carrier Performance Air Conditioner (26SPA6)](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/carrier-26spa6/): Up to 16.5 SEER2 with Carrier reliability.
- [Trane XV18 Variable-Speed Air Conditioner](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/trane-xv18/): Variable-speed TruComfort cooling, quiet as 55 dB.
- [Lennox Elite EL18KSLV Heat Pump](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/lennox-el18kslv/): Slim side-discharge cold-climate heat pump, made for Canada.
- [TOSOT APEX Central Heat Pump](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/tosot-apex/): Inverter central heat pump that heats down to −30 °C.
- [Kepler Heat Pump](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/kepler-ac/): Clean, modern outdoor unit that heats and cools your home.
- [Midea Inverter Heat Pump](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/midea-hp/): Efficient inverter heating & cooling for rooms or whole homes.
- [Gree Ductless Mini-Split Heat Pump](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/gree-minisplit/): Cools and heats rooms with no ductwork.
- [Reznor UDX Garage & Shop Heater](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/reznor-udx/): Rugged power-vented Reznor unit heater, up to 83% efficient — built for prairie shops.
- [Modine Hot Dawg HD45 Garage Heater](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/modine-hd45/): The classic 2-car garage heater — low profile and power vented.
- [Lennox LF24 45,000 BTU Garage Heater](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/lennox-lf24/): Quiet, low-profile Lennox unit heater for garages and utility rooms.
- [Re-Verber-Ray DR-50 High-Intensity Infrared Heater](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/rvr-dr50/): Glowing ceramic infrared heat for shops, bays and big doors.
- [Re-Verber-Ray Designer Series Patio Heater](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/rvr-designer/): Stylish stainless infrared heat for decks, patios and restaurant terraces.
- [Navien NPE-240A2 Tankless Water Heater](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/navien-npe240a2/): Built-in recirculation for hot water faster.
- [Rinnai RX199iN Condensing Tankless](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/rinnai-rx199in/): Up to 11.1 GPM and 0.98 UEF, Wi-Fi built in.
- [Rheem Super High Efficiency Tankless](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/rheem-ikonic/): Condensing tankless with built-in recirculation.
- [Bradford White Infiniti GS 199 Tankless](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/bw-infiniti-gs/): Made-tough condensing tankless, 199,000 BTU.
- [Noritz EZ Series EZTR50 Tankless](https://joramechanicalsystems.com/saskatchewan/products/noritz-eztr50/): Drop-in replacement for a 50-gallon tank.
